action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (0.74) with moderate seasonality (0.47) and ambiguous stationarity. Model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall tau 0.064) and 17 of 19 models fall into just 2 correlated-error groups, meaning most models carry redundant information. Under these conditions, a robust combination like the DTW barycenter (dba) that does not overfit to the noisy per-window ranking is well-suited. The leader's margin over the runner-up (0.0025) is statistically indistinguishable given only 3 windows, and the dataset card confirms dba and trimmed_mean are among the top strategies on this dataset. Accepting the seed leader is the right call.
